web_workload detection-mix-v1 cycles GET /synthetic plus the five detection.SuspiciousPaths per protocol in scheduled ordinal order: /.env, /.git/config, /wp-login.php, /wp-admin, /phpmyadmin. It exercises WEB-REPEAT candidate/evidence storage; no exploit payload is sent. Overload drops preserve the scheduled path order rather than catch up. Report records the cycle; actual transmitted mix may differ when inputs drop. Single-source loopback traffic exercises repeated-source thresholds, not broad source cardinality.
